# MASTER REFERENCE APPENDIX — Day 9 / P8: Professional Product

> This appendix is part of [Master issue #1](https://github.com/M9nx/CareerHub/issues/1). It is the exact file boundary for this phase.

- **Phase issue:** #PHASE_P8
- **Owner:** M9nx (all packages)
- **Capacity:** 6 packages × 8 hours = 48 hours
- **Outcome:** `/feed` is a mixed chronological timeline; in-app inbox; discovery; professional UI; production hardening.
- **Exit gate:** Timeline is the default authenticated home; Pest suite green; polish matches Swiss/Breeze tokens already in the app.

## Locked product decisions for P8

1. **Feed becomes a timeline** — mixed stream (posts, published jobs, application events the viewer is allowed to see), newest first.
2. **Composer lives on the timeline** — both Employer and Employee can post without leaving `/feed`.
3. **Mail stays; inbox is added** — application mail from P5 remains; P8 adds database notifications and a bell inbox.
4. **No new third-party services** — local disk, existing stack (Laravel, Breeze, Filament, Pest).
5. **SuperAdmin stays Filament-only** — timeline/inbox/discovery are Breeze persona surfaces.

## Rules for every package in this appendix

1. Do not start until the learning evidence is recorded.
2. Create or modify only the files listed under the active WBS ID.
3. Stop and ask M9nx before creating, renaming, moving, or editing an unlisted path.
4. Each package is a **full vertical slice** — migration, model, policy, controller/resource, views, and tests belong together for that day's scope.
5. The package closes only after tests, evidence, required reviews, PR linkage, and gates pass.
6. Dependencies are `-`. Prefer Timeline before Composer if both are open.

## P8-Timeline — M9nx

- **Leaf issue:** #LEAF_P8_Timeline
- **Task:** Turn `/feed` from a post-only card list into a mixed chronological timeline.
- **Must learn before starting:** Timeline composition queries; pagination of mixed types
- **Dependencies:** `-`
- **Branch:** `feat/#LEAF_P8_Timeline-timeline-feed`
- **Reviewers:** M9nx
- **Scope:** Core

### Exact file contracts

| File | Action | What must be written | Minimum example/contract |
|---|---|---|---|
| `app/Support/Timeline/TimelineItem.php` | Create | Value object: type, occurred_at, subject, actor. | Types: post, job_published, application_event. |
| `app/Support/Timeline/TimelineQuery.php` | Create | Merge published posts, published jobs, viewer-visible application events; sort desc; paginate. | Employer sees applications on own jobs; employee sees own applications. |
| `app/Http/Controllers/FeedController.php` | Modify | Use TimelineQuery; pass `$items` to the view. | Keep route `feed.index`. |
| `resources/views/feed/index.blade.php` | Modify | Timeline layout instead of post-only list. | Vertical time spine; newest first. |
| `resources/views/feed/partials/timeline-item.blade.php` | Create | Render one item by type. | Post body, job title link, application status label. |
| `tests/Feature/Post/TimelineFeedTest.php` | Create | Mixed types appear in chronological order; guests redirected. | Hidden posts and draft jobs omitted. |
